$comment: The publishable corpus. Every entry is pinned by SHA and public, so this file can ship with the benchmark unchanged. Local-only and synthetic entries live in src/fixtures.ts and are never published. Shapes here exist because a real bug lived in them — see the rationale on each entry and docs/scan-regression-harness-plan.md in clarx-cloud.

repos.rationale: Next.js App Router with a components/ui shadcn directory. Covers the framework the engine once assumed by default (PA-001) and the C2 false positives on generated shadcn files (PA-004).

Vite + React SPA monorepo with genuinely oversized files. Covers the framework the engine once assumed away (PA-001) and the C2 severity gradient between marginally-over and clearly-over files (PA-002).
Small TypeScript library with barrel-style re-exports. Covers export counting on `export * from` files (PA-005).
Mid-size TypeScript framework with deep module structure. Exercises the import graph and boundary rules on thin-route-style code (KUA-003, KUA-007).
pnpm monorepo with real workspaces. Exercises cross-package import resolution and the workspaces manifest key.
The small end of the size distribution. A repo this small should not accumulate structural findings; if it does, a threshold is miscalibrated.
Non-JS repository. The JS-only rules must report `inapplicable` rather than failing — a rule silently flipping to inapplicable is the change this corpus exists to catch.
A second non-JS stack, so `inapplicable` behaviour is not validated against Python alone.
